title: Bind and execute the first selected whole-family prefix
body:
I close the whole-family alignment and bank-access boundary for the selected call 0's first two scalar events. PR2370 states their reference semantics but leaves the common-chart premise open. I derive that premise from the actual stage-zero data routes, zero Y entrance translations and frame 0, then prove a disjoint-packet factorization that moves this prefix before the cover tails.

I use the executor to acquire complete families 119/169 from a bank of 14,336 families, apply `SCALE -1/2; ADD +1/2`, construct the replacement bank and commit it through an explicit ownership boundary. I retain the scalar intermediate guards and charge full-bank scans, copies, return consumption and erasure: O(B+v) time and O(B+v+h+log B) additional transient space. The caller closes that work before a recursive tail cut.

I passed seven registered cold checks on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64: exact source/chart binding and six mutation controls; disjoint-route factorization; encoded 15 Gamma extent; complete finite banks at N=1/3; arithmetic failure/reuse and nested caller commit. I also checked the source/error cases under `-O` and reran both source checks after binding the actual first execution-schedule entry.

I tested the complete bank primitive at small generic extents. I did not execute the full O(73,2) payload. In PROOF.md I give the all-N argument and its mixed-radix layout premise. I leave the tail, helper-chart census, full caller invoice and inherited precision reserve outside this replay. I claim no new exponent or full multiplication theorem.

I credit James Chang's PR2370 reference prefix, Ali Romman's PR1969 transport/data phases, Gareth Davidson's PR1255 chart/phase discipline, ywz65's PR2591 prepared half-ADD, and the retained arithmetic/physical-framework sources in the frozen PR3098 archive. SOURCES.json records their exact heads and credit. I preserve PR2287's whole-row specification and leave the selected frontier unchanged.

Reproduce: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-first-prefix`.

Canonical coordination: [2238#18986017](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2238#discussioncomment-18986017). I refreshed canonical main at 01:02:22 UTC and checked live overlap through 01:03:03 UTC; I found no relevant change or matching claim in that coverage.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including analysis subagents. I claim no hosted CI, independent human or proof-assistant verification. Apache-2.0 with retained predecessor notices.
